summary: [[character:linus]] reaches [[location:epsilon-indi]] and finds [[character:henry-roberts]], an isolated Australian replicant trapped in a failing improvised structure. He recovers Henry's core and uses a realistic sailing [[technology:vr]] to help him regain lucidity while traumatic memories gradually become less intense.

introducing.name: Epsilon Indi
introducing.description: A stellar system centered on a cooler, smaller K-type star than [[location:sol]]. Potentially livable worlds would orbit close to the star and would be likely to be tidally locked. Its only notable planet is the Jovian [[location:epsilon-indi-1]], just outside the habitable zone. [[character:linus]] arrives in 2165; the system lies eleven light-years from [[location:earth]] and fourteen from [[location:epsilon-eridani]].

introducing.name: Epsilon Indi 1
introducing.description: A Jovian planet slightly outside [[location:epsilon-indi]]'s habitable zone.

introducing.name: Henry Roberts
introducing.description: A former solo sailor, who knew his boat the [[vessel:contessa]] in detail, chosen by [[organization:australia]] to be the replicant of the [[vessel:australian-probe]]. [[character:linus]] finds him at [[location:epsilon-indi]], psychotic after long sensory deprivation.
introducing.current_state: Recovering in a realistic virtual sailing life after [[character:linus]] extracts his core from long isolation. He is lucid there but believes he is back on [[location:earth]], and memories of his replicant years return as nightmares.

introducing.name: Heaven-8
introducing.description: A [[organization:free-american-independent-theocratic-hegemony]] ship identified by [[character:linus]] as his vessel.

introducing.name: Australian probe
introducing.description: An Australian space probe built around a replicant core, fusion reactor, and [[technology:autofactory]] systems. Its hardware was partly disassembled and incorporated into an improvised structure at [[location:epsilon-indi]].

introducing.name: Contessa
introducing.description: A sailing vessel Henry knew in detail during his human life. [[character:linus]] reconstructs it in virtual reality so Henry can sail again while recovering.

updates.current_state: At [[location:epsilon-indi]] after a time-dilated solo journey from [[location:epsilon-eridani]], maintaining a realistic [[technology:vr]] setting while helping Henry recover from traumatic isolation.

updates.description: A virtual-reality interface [[character:bob-replicant]] builds aboard [[vessel:heaven-1]] to give a bodiless mind sensory input and an embodied experience. Still an ongoing software project, it produces physical sensations that feel real and a full humanlike avatar, and planned improvements aim at more direct interaction between users. It can render interactive objects such as a Nerf basketball and hoop, and [[character:linus]] uses it to give Henry a realistic sailing life, bodily functions included.
